hypothesis: A standalone ordered top-three Plackett-Luce distribution built from daily frozen global racer and racer-by-official-course states can expose an orthogonal signal without fitting to v312 probabilities.

inputs.target: dataset/targets.npy used only for post-date state updates

state.unknown_racer_code: a unique neutral key per race and lane; it never shares history with another unknown entry
state.rank_encoding: first=0, second=1, third=2, remaining three tied=3
state.update_order: emit all current-date feature rows, then update all current-date ratings
state.course_missing: course_delta=0, course_starts_log=0, course_available=0, and no course-state update

prediction.distribution: exact 120 ordered top-three probabilities from shared-score Plackett-Luce sequential sampling

selection.promotion: requires a new separately preregistered final protocol and a direct v312 comparison

forbidden: v312 probability as a training input
